test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average score of 30 students (boys and girls only) in a class test was 16.2 and that of 18 boys in the same test was 16. The average score of girls in the same test was:
solution:
**Given:**

Average score of 30 students = 16.2

Number of students = 30

Average score of 18 boys = 16

Number of boys = 18

Number of girls = 30 - 18 = 12

**Formula Used:**

Average score = Total score / Number of students

**Calculation:**

Total score of 30 students = Average score × Number of stud
